_meta.note: Calibrated to published clearance patterns (GNWL clears first and fastest, RLWL and PQWL slower, TQWL worst), not real IRCTC historical PNR data -- that data is not publicly available outside IRCTC/CRIS. probability = clamp(1 - position / (clearance_ceiling * seasonal_modifier), 0, 1) * 100. Band: >70 confirm, 30-70 probable, <30 low.

quotas.description: GNWL, the general queue. It clears before RLWL and PQWL because it draws from the full quota.
RLWL has a small separate quota for a remote boarding point and rarely clears this late.
PQWL draws from a pooled quota shared across intermediate stations, and clears less predictably than GNWL.
TQWL is the Tatkal waitlist -- the smallest quota and the worst odds of the four.
